# Fine Finishes NW

> Fine Finishes NW is a locally owned painting contractor serving Southwest Washington and the Portland, Oregon metro. Interior, exterior, cabinet, commercial and new-construction painting. Licensed, bonded and insured in Washington and Oregon; in business since 2009.

- Phone: (360) 635-1080
- Service area: Clark County, WA and the Portland, OR metro
- Hours: Monday-Friday, 7am-5pm

## Services
- [Interior Painting](https://finefinishesnw.com/interior-painting.html): Interior house painting: walls, ceilings, trim, doors, stairwells and cabinetry, with full surface prep and daily site cleanup.
- [Exterior Painting](https://finefinishesnw.com/exterior-painting.html): Exterior house painting and staining for Pacific Northwest weather: siding, trim, soffits, decks and railings, with pressure washing, scraping, priming and premium topcoats.
- [New Construction Painting](https://finefinishesnw.com/new-construction.html): Production painting and finishing for custom-home builders: primer through final coat, schedule-driven, with punch-list walkthroughs.
- [Cabinet Refinishing](https://finefinishesnw.com/cabinet-refinishing.html): Refinishing existing kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities and built-ins: degreased, deglossed, sanded, bonding-primed and sprayed with a cabinet-grade topcoat.
- [Commercial Painting](https://finefinishesnw.com/commercial-painting.html): Interior and exterior painting for offices, retail, restaurants, medical suites and multi-unit residential property, scheduled around business hours.
- [House Painting](https://finefinishesnw.com/services.html): Interior and exterior painting, cabinet refinishing, new-construction finishing and commercial painting.
